rows.title: The germinal products set's pages carry the service's shared chrome, with its home links pointing at the set's own root
rows.detail: Germinal products is its own sibling set beside live animals in the same animals service, mounted at its own prefix. A trader moving between the two sets must see one service, not two: the same service navigation, the same phase banner and footer, the same browser-title pattern, the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners. The parts of the chrome that belong to a set rather than to the service - the home link behind the service name, the Dashboard item and its current state, and the chrome an error page is drawn in - must resolve inside the germinal set, so a trader working on a germinal notification is always taken back to the germinal set's own root and never into live animals. The shared layout already works a page's set out from the longest mount prefix its path starts with, so this is wiring the new set into chrome that already exists rather than changing the chrome itself.
acceptanceCriteria: Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items, in the same order, as a live animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009)
Every germinal products page shows the Alpha phase banner with its feedback link, and the footer, as live animals pages do (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Every germinal products page's browser title reads '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows validation errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Germinal products journey pages show the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners as the live animals page each one is copied from (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

On every germinal products page the service name and the Dashboard navigation item link to the germinal products set's own root at /germinal-products, and following either one lands there (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009, repo-frontend-p2-013, repo-frontend-p2-128; conflicts:c-314)

Dashboard is the current navigation item at the germinal products set's root and on every page inside a germinal products notification (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Opening an address under the germinal products set that does not exist shows 'Page not found' in the germinal set's chrome, with the service name linking to the germinal products set's own root (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-131, repo-frontend-p2-132; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p13-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008)

rows.notes: One slice (req-1907), and not one that stands apart: none of this chrome can be observed until the germinal products set is mounted and its first page exists, so it needs the same set, mount and first page as the set's own first row. existingRow inc-176 already holds req-1907 with criteria that say the same thing; the combiner keeps inc-176's id, theme (germinal-products), repos (backend as well, for the stored category), gate, dependsOn and externalDependsOn, and merges these criteria with the ones already there rather than making a second row. The repos given here are this draft's own need - the germinal set in the animals frontend and the germinal end-to-end, accessibility and security specs - so the draft stands on its own. c-314 overrules the morning ruling's redirect of a set root to a notification list in the front door, so no criterion here hands the trader on to another service; the germinal list the set root renders is another row's to build, and the links criterion is observable before it lands, from where the links go. The shared layout, the set-scoped paths and the error chrome already resolve per set, so this row should change no shared file; journey-foundation has split off, so if the plan finds a shared file must change, that change belongs on its branch and this row consumes it. The germinal set's own service-navigation fit spec is a copy inside the set folder: the live animals one is the split-off type-question-and-templates theme's and is not edited here. req-1907 also says a path under no set takes the set-free chrome; that is today's behaviour for every such path and this row changes nothing about it, so it carries no criterion of its own.

rows.title: The performance suite judges the front door ready by the home's own main heading
rows.detail: The performance suite will not start a run until the stack is functionally ready, and it judges the front door ready by opening its home signed in and matching the main heading exactly. When the home's main heading becomes 'Import notification service', the probe has to change in the same increment: changed first it breaks every run on the main branch, and changed late every run's readiness fails after five minutes. The address book probe and the rule that the stack is ready only when every probe has passed once both stay as they are. The heading itself belongs to the front door's overall home, which is held until the front door dashboard's requirements are agreed, so this waits with it.
acceptanceCriteria: The performance suite's 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe passes when the front door's home answers 200 to a signed-in trader with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflicts:c-146)
The 'address book read' readiness probe still passes only when the front door's address book answers 200 with the heading 'Address book' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-041)

The stack counts as functionally ready only when one pass succeeds for all six readiness probes, and readiness otherwise fails after 300 seconds naming the probes that failed (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-042)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door home's 'Import notification service' main heading names the overall home, which the 9 October afternoon ruling holds as front-door dashboard summary information until its requirements firm up and are agreed (c-146). Who: whoever owns the front door dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with the product owner, after which the dashboard area is re-distilled; until then the probe keeps the heading it matches today.
The probe changes only in the increment that changes the heading: changing it first breaks every performance run on the main branch, so it never stands apart.
rows.notes: One slice (req-1905), and not one that stands apart: the probe matches the heading exactly, so the probe and the heading change together or every run breaks. existingRow inc-128 already holds req-1905 with the heading change and with these three readiness criteria; the combiner keeps it there, in the ins-dashboard theme, with inc-128's own repos (insfrontend, tests, perftests) and perftests last, and does not make a second row. The repos given here are this draft's own need - the front door whose heading the probe matches, then the suite that matches it - so the draft stands on its own. The heading change itself sits in the front door's dashboard feature template and copy, which the split-off type-question-and-templates theme touches, and the suite also checks the home's heading in its front-door script, which the split-off address-book theme touches; both were in inc-128 before those themes split off, so they stay there and are listed in shared rather than touches. This draft's own code is the readiness script in the performance-tests repo, which no theme split off early touches. The six-probe rule and the 300-second timeout are read from the readiness script and the suite's smoke config; neither needs editing for this change.
